title: Federal learning training method and device for high-delay network environment robustness
assignee: Ping An Technology Shenzhen Co Ltd

pse.problem: Federated learning training method based on synchronous parameter aggregation technology is inefficient in high-latency network environments due to severe network delay.
pse.solution_function: The invention introduces a robust federated learning training method that adapts to high-latency network environments. It coordinates time, network delay values, and system time to ensure all encrypted data from multiple data uploading terminals are received before resuming local federal learning training.
pse.solution_structure: The key components include a system clock for acquiring current system time, network delay value sensors for measuring network delays of target data uploading terminals, and a storage device to store the called unit time sequence interval step length.
pse.solution_implementation: The method begins by judging if encrypted data from each terminal is received. If not, it identifies target data uploading terminals, measures network delays of these terminals, calculates a delay step based on maximum network delay and the called unit time sequence interval step length, sums current system time with the delay step to obtain target system time, and resumes training only when all target encrypted data are received.
pse.effect: The solution improves training efficiency by allowing federal learning to function properly even in networks with high latency, such as those commonly found between remote nodes.
